confidence_notes: Medium overall. Restaurant, coffee, beer, cocktail and wine anchors come from 2026-dated aggregated sources (Numbeo user-reported data republished by Expatica with a 1 June 2026 snapshot, Expatistan, and travel guides), not official surveys. July peak-season prices may run above these averages. Cocktail and wine rest on sparse listing data and were cross-checked against the beer anchor ratio. Accommodation anchors are holistic model estimates from general knowledge for July peak season; no live booking pages, current listings or accommodation searches were used. FX caveat: the RBA overview page snapshot seen in search shows 0.7088 dated 2026-03-20. A later third-party-reported figure for 2026-10-27 could not be confirmed on rba.gov.au, so the FX row is older than the 2026-11-19 generation date and the RBA daily F11.1 table was not confirmed.
comparable_city_reasoning: No single comparable city was used for food and drink. Those anchors are Lisbon-specific aggregated 2026 price points. Euro prices were converted to USD at about 1.14 USD per EUR, an approximate rate implied by a third-party Lisbon price listing and not an RBA figure. Accommodation anchors are calibrated against general knowledge of summer demand in Southern European capitals.
